name: hello-world
summary: Hello World demo plugin for jPulse Framework
description:
This demo plugin showcases the jPulse Framework plugin system with:

  • Dynamic Configuration: Tab-based settings with various field types
  • MVC Components: Controller, Model, and View integration
  • Append Mode: Extending framework CSS and JavaScript

Use this as a reference when creating your own plugins.
author: jPulse Team <team@jpulse.net>

schema.content:
Welcome! This is a demo plugin showcasing the dynamic configuration system. Fields are grouped into tabs based on the 'tab' attribute.

For site-wide Hello settings (welcome message, show badge), see Site Configuration → Hello tab.

schema.label: Plugin Hello Message
schema.help: This message will be displayed on the Hello World page

schema.label: Show statistics
schema.help: Display plugin statistics on the page

schema.content: Demo API key: type: "password" marks a secret. Bulk reads return ******** when a value is stored. The server reads the real value with PluginModel.getSecret(). This key is not sent anywhere — it exists so plugin authors can copy the pattern.

schema.label: Demo API Key
schema.help: Masked in GET config. Reveal on this form is audited. Verify reads the stored value on the server.

schema.label: Verify demo key
schema.help: Asks the server whether a key is stored. The button never receives the value.

schema.content: 🧩 Custom Field Renderer: The field below is not one of the built-in types — it's rendered entirely by this plugin's own JavaScript, demonstrating the type: "custom" escape hatch for config UIs that don't fit a flat schema.

schema.label: Quick Links
schema.help: Mini list editor (label + URL pairs) stored as a JSON array. The framework treats this value as opaque — see plugins/hello-world/webapp/view/jpulse-common.js for the renderer.
